name: Moowit
summary: Experience the creative world of Moowit's music and artistry.

quote.text: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord

bio: Moowit is on a mission to bring the message of hope, faith, and love to the dance floor. Combining powerful EDM beats with uplifting Christian themes, every track is designed to inspire and energize the soul.

From worship anthems to high-energy festival bangers, Moowit creates music that celebrates faith while making you move. It's not just about the drop—it's about lifting spirits and bringing people together in praise.
